When competition between components is mediated by shared resources with feature or niche vectors u_i, so that A = UᵀU and r = Uᵀb − c, the Lotka–Volterra dynamics are ṅ_i = −n_i ∂_i L with L(n) = ½‖b − Un‖² + cᵀn: entropic mirror descent on the positive orthant. A rare component's invasion fitness is −∂_i L, the value of adding that feature, and uninvadable equilibria are the KKT points of the convex program. The sharp edge: the identity needs a shared scalar objective, and it fails for asymmetric interactions or processes with competing objectives, which is where an organization stops being an optimizer. Mehta et al. (2019) and Marsland, Cui and Mehta (2020) give the general duality for consumer–resource models. | Active |

If the collective decision is the authority-weighted mean of the operators' policies, then granting influence to an ally whose policy is nearer one's own than the decision is moves the decision strictly toward one's policy. So the reward for realized policy, and not for held authority, pays for delegating. It does not say operators behave so, or that any rule beyond one hop keeps both conditions. | Active |

| [CLAIM-400](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-400.md) v6 | A legibility state adds a mode to the loop | [QUESTION-253](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-253.md) asked whether authority's effect on what becomes legible as evidence is a third channel with its own instability condition, or [CLAIM-340](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-340.md)'s κ′ renamed. | [CLAIM-597](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-597.md) v5 | Independent of founders, never of feeders | The assistant's, on the owner's invitation of 2026-11-05 to add readings and claims to the DNA origami filing. Two readings separate formation from upkeep. Scheckenbach et al. 2021: folded origami regenerates from a pool of strands in solution. In serum, matching staples keep 76 % of structures intact over 11 days against 12 % without, but only at low damage rates, and the supply was never withdrawn. Zhou et al. 2021: in replicating origami the species that comes to dominate does so independent of the initial seed, yet every cycle needs fresh monomers, a thermal program and UV. In a one-line model with damage at d and supplied repair at ρs, the intact fraction is ρs/(ρs + d). Holding a share θ needs ρs = d·θ/(1 − θ), 9d for 90 % and 99d for 99 %, and withdrawal returns decay at the damage rate. Such regeneration is not closure: the turnover [CLAIM-516](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-516.md) excludes, basal external production, is exactly what these systems run on. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Active |
| [CLAIM-603](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-603.md) v9 | The supply, not the loss, decides dependency | The assistant's, on the owner's remark of 2026-11-05 that "assured help makes recipients lose skill" sounds "closely related to niche differentiation and specialization phenomena". The record holds the biology. On the Black Queen Hypothesis ([THEORY-1048](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1048.md)) a cell that stops making a leaky public good saves its cost while others still supply it, so the loss is favoured to the individual and spreads. Buchnera ([THEORY-1103](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-1103.md)) has lost the genes its host covers and kept those its host lacks. The Samaritan's dilemma has the same logic (Ostrom et al.), and Azam, Devarajan and O'Connell's recipient is better off in the high-aid state. The loss itself is not the pathology. What differs is the supply. A Black Queen loss stops by itself when helpers grow rare, because the helpers are the same population. Aid is set from outside and does not fall as dependence grows, so nothing stops the loss short of what aid covers, and withdrawal returns the cost ([CLAIM-602](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-602.md)). Buchnera's loss runs both ways, and the result is interdependence. A state that taxes its citizens (Moore) is in the same position: it lost nothing, it exchanges. After the owner linked the claim to the gift economy of Burning Man, readings of Mauss, of St John on Burning Man and of Heins, Unrau and Avram added two things. One-way supply costs the receiver standing as well as capacity: in Mauss the unreturned gift makes its receiver inferior. And the return need not go back to the giver: it can travel round a circuit, as Mauss's do, or out to a whole community, as Burning Man's is meant to, and both sit beside a demand for self-reliance. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |

The record separates order held by an outside flow, the Bénard cell, from order that keeps up the conditions of its own maintenance, the candle flame ([THEORY-072](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-072.md), [TERM-070](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-070.md), [QUESTION-085](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-085.md)). [CLAIM-597](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-597.md) modelled only the first. The second is modelled by letting uptake from the flux scale with the intact share: dI/dt = −dI + κsI²(1 − I). With d = 0.2 and κs = 2 the structure holds 0.887, as supplied repair at ρs = 1.575 does, but it goes out from 0.10 with the supply on, collapses when the supply falls below 40 % of its level, and after an outage longer than about 10.3 time units does not relight when the supply returns. Supplied repair recovers from any start and declines smoothly. Both decay as e^(−dt) once the supply stops, so the self-maintaining structure is no less dependent on the flux. (A) An equilibrium with every operator present is locally exponentially stable if each trait is interior and stationary or held at a bound by a strictly outward gradient, and the Hessian of L on the free coordinates is positive definite. Its abundance block is the Gram matrix, so the niche vectors must be linearly independent: no more specialists than niche dimensions, and no two the same. An undifferentiated equilibrium is never asymptotically stable. (B) With residents' traits frozen, a specialist removed and reintroduced rare grows at λ_i ≥ n*_i d_i² ≥ n*_i λ_min(A*), where d_i is the distance of its niche vector from the span of the others'. Equality holds in the first when no other operator goes extinct in its absence. This extends [CASE-118](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-118.md) to k components. | [CLAIM-1046](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-1046.md) v2 | Probe partitions are not the decomposition lattice | A15 §2 says "the lattice of all partitions of Ω is generally much larger than the set of partitions realizable by our affordable probes", and that the probe lattice "is a structure of which distinctions our methods support", not of selves. It gives no argument and does not say how the two orders relate. They relate as follows. For fixed configurations Ω and fixed response laws, let π(Q) be the partition of Ω into classes no probe in Q separates. Then π(Q1 ∪ Q2) is the meet (common refinement) of π(Q1) and π(Q2), while π(Q1 ∩ Q2) is at least as coarse as their join and can be strictly coarser. So π is order-reversing and meet-preserving, its image is a meet-closed part of the partition lattice and need not be a sublattice, and with m probes it has at most 2^m members, against Bell(\|Ω\|) partitions (32 against 115,975 for m = 5 and \|Ω\| = 10). Checked with python3 -I on 3,000 random probe systems (no union failed; the intersection was strictly coarser than the join in 100) and on an explicit case.
